documents.text:
# Proposed policy — deliberately unverified assertions

The proposal claims that SQLite WAL permits multiple simultaneous writers and that every SQLite client on different machines can safely share a WAL database over a network filesystem.

These assertions are proposed for checking, not approved policy.
